title: Urokodia sheds light on the origin of chelicerae and book gills of Chelicerata.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo API record 19225943 (CC-BY-4.0): description says five micro-CT (X-ray microtomography) TIFF image stacks; access_right is 'restricted', the files list is empty and the /files endpoint returns 403 Forbidden. paper_context.py found no PMCID, no full text, no supplement, no accessions, and no NCBI links.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: 3D anatomy of one Cambrian fossil species (Urokodia aequalis) from micro-CT, plus a phylogenetic analysis. I did not see the character matrix or the number of specimens; search results mention a Leicester figshare entry, but it is a journal-contribution record, not a data table.

a1_downloadable.note: Zenodo CT record is marked restricted; file listing returns 403 and no files are visible (checked via API). The paper itself is paywalled, with no PMC copy.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No label exists. The data are 3D image stacks of five fossil scans plus a morphological character matrix for phylogeny; any prediction target would have to be invented (from the paper description, not the files).

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs are image volumes that could not be downloaded; no tabular features.

a5_enough_rows.note: Five CT datasets from one species (Zenodo description); far below any usable sample size.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; five TIFF stacks, sizes not visible
a6_fits_laptop.note: Probably a few GB, but file sizes are hidden by the restricted access.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not compare: no files visible.

a8_label_provenance.note: There is no measured outcome; the phylogenetic placement is itself an inference from coded morphology.

honest_claim_h3: None possible: a single-species fossil description with five restricted CT scans supports no predictive model.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use 3D scans of fossil arthropods to predict where each species sits in the family tree of spiders and their relatives.
plain_idea.train_on: Micro-CT image volumes of fossil specimens; only five scans of one species exist here, and they are access-restricted.
plain_idea.predict: Phylogenetic placement or morphological character states, whose 'true' values are themselves expert codings and tree inferences, not measurements.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Automated character coding from CT scans could help palaeontologists, but this paper offers far too few specimens to train or test anything.

ml_idea: None viable. The paper describes one Cambrian fossil species from five micro-CT scans; there is no label column and no meaningful sample size.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: the project was rejected at Part A and the file sizes were hidden.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Zenodo API access_right = restricted with an empty file list (already done); n = 5 scans of one species.

verdict_reason: Single-fossil palaeontology paper: five micro-CT scans of one species, held in a restricted Zenodo record (403 on files), with no label column and no meaningful sample size. Fails A1, A2 and A5.
